Bridge an inbound call leg to an ElevenLabs Conversational AI agent over a SIP trunk gateway. The gateway is provisioned manually from the ElevenLabs dashboard (see docs/admin/elevenlabs-freeswitch.md).
Variables: extension_number - dialed Odoo extension (regex anchor) agent_uid - ElevenLabs agent_id passed in the SIP user part and as X-Agent-Id header gateway_name - sofia gateway name (convention: 'elevenlabs')

<extension name="elevenlabs_agent_{{ extension_number }}"> <condition field="destination_number" expression="^{{ extension_number }}$"> <action application="set" data="hangup_after_bridge=true"/> <action application="set" data="continue_on_fail=true"/> <action application="set" data="sip_h_X-Agent-Id={{ agent_uid }}"/> <action application="answer"/> <action application="bridge" data="sofia/gateway/{{ gateway_name }}/{{ agent_uid }}"/> </condition> </extension>

<extension name="elevenlabs_agent_{{ extension_number }}"> <condition field="destination_number" expression="^{{ extension_number }}$"> <action application="set" data="hangup_after_bridge=true"/> <action application="set" data="continue_on_fail=true"/> <action application="set" data="sip_h_X-Agent-Id={{ agent_uid }}"/> <action application="answer"/> <action application="bridge" data="sofia/gateway/{{ gateway_name }}/{{ agent_uid }}"/> </condition> </extension>

Stream call audio over WebSocket to the connect_elevenlabs relay via mod_audio_stream. Relay terminates the stream and bridges into ElevenLabs Conversational AI. Requires mod_audio_stream loaded in FreeSWITCH (ADR-016) and pcm_16000 audio format on the agent.
Variables: extension_number - dialed Odoo extension (regex anchor) agent_uid - ElevenLabs agent_id, embedded in the WSS path wss_base_url - relay base URL (wss://...), no trailing slash

<extension name="elevenlabs_agent_stream_{{ extension_number }}"> <condition field="destination_number" expression="^{{ extension_number }}$"> <action application="set" data="hangup_after_bridge=true"/> <action application="answer"/> <action application="set" data="audio_stream_metadata={"agent_uid":"{{ agent_uid }}"}"/> <action application="audio_stream" data="start {{ wss_base_url }}/freeswitch/stream/{{ agent_uid }}/${uuid}/${uuid} mono 16k"/> <action application="park"/> </condition> </extension>

<extension name="elevenlabs_agent_stream_{{ extension_number }}"> <condition field="destination_number" expression="^{{ extension_number }}$"> <action application="set" data="hangup_after_bridge=true"/> <action application="answer"/> <action application="set" data="audio_stream_metadata={"agent_uid":"{{ agent_uid }}"}"/> <action application="audio_stream" data="start {{ wss_base_url }}/freeswitch/stream/{{ agent_uid }}/${uuid}/${uuid} mono 16k"/> <action application="park"/> </condition> </extension>
